about: Every self-developed BeamingFace component and its version. Content-bound: scripts/clued_components.py check fails when a component's files change without a version bump. The service reports these versions in /.well-known/clued-continuity and clued_session_resume; scripts/hooks/clued_version_check.py compares them with this machine. Task 6dfd7560.
